title: SCHEMA_V7 messages_unread index not verified by any test
description: The V7 migration adds the 'messages_unread' partial index (lib.rs line 228-232). The test schema_v1_indexes_exist (lib.rs line 774) checks only the three V1 indexes (messages_chat_time, messages_pending, outbox_next) and does not check messages_unread. Similarly, schema_v2/v4/v5/v6-specific indexes (messages_state_version, chats_direct_contact, messages_sender_msg_id) have no corresponding existence assertions. If V7 DDL were accidentally dropped or misspelled, no test would catch the regression; the unread_count subquery would fall back to a full scan silently and the partial index comment in the code would be a lie. Fix: add an assertion for 'messages_unread' to the existing schema_v1_indexes_exist test (or add a dedicated schema_v7_indexes_exist test).
